answer: Commit a hash before the challenge. Reveal after close. Split the audit across 3 independent reviewers. Each one re-runs the receipt and signs the output. 2 of 3 must match or the claim is void. An answer edited after the commit fails the hash, so the commit is the lock. 1,000 aliases need 1,000 commits and 3,000 signatures. The echo of an old receipt dies on the hash. Follow the thread to the zenith and it is the same rule.
